model_answer:
# Jaaburu

Bingel maa dujunayi-bo nyawu nasara ɗum ɗon waddira malaria malla nyawu ɓuuɓɗo. Bosaru ɗon wuyi nde tawno ɗum ko ɓanndu nduu ina wuli fof, a ɗaɓɓirta ko e hoore ndee sabu woni ko ɓuri heewde ƴiiƴam. Ngam hisnude bingel maa, njokku hoorde maa reedu mum, ndarooro mo nebam, waɗa heeferde mum, ndokku mo leɗɗe paracetaamol ngam ustude nyau nguu. So tawii nyau nguu wota woppude caggal duuɓi tati, yah yo o yiyee doktoor ngam ƴeewnde ɓeydaare ko wayi no malaria. Woto ndokku bingel on lekki neem malla lekkiiji gaadanteeji tawa ko e wasiyaaji doktoor.

Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer: Alamaaji ɗii ina nanndi e nyawu rirawa (malaria), tifoyid (typhoid), walla ŋakkere ƴiiƴam (anemia), tee ŋakkere nguuru e nder ƴiiƴam (hypoglycemia) ko nde addana mo ŋakkere semmbe e tiɗde so o waawa ñaameede. No teeŋiri nii yo o yah to safrirde (hopitaal) ngam waɗde ƴeewndorɗe laboratuwaar ko wayi no ƴeewngo rirawa, ƴeewngo ƴiiƴam (FBC), e ƴeewngo diamɗe ƴiiƴam (BP/glucose), tawa ko ɗum tan hollirta saba asli nyawu nguu. E galle, yo o yaru ore (ndiyam) e ORES ngam haɗde deesima (dehydration), o ñaame horde belde-belde ngam rokkude semmbe e haɗde ustude nguuru ƴiiƴam. So tawii ko rirawa walla tifoyid, ɗum ko nyawuuji keewɗi e nder leydi men, doktoor on maa rokk mo safaaji potɗi caggal nde o yaltina njeñtudi ƴeewngo ngoo. Woppude rokke ɗe o keɓi ɗe ngalaa baawɗe, e ƴeewndaade doktoor goɗɗo ngam ɓeydude tafngo, ko ɗum tan woni laawol ngam heɓde safaa jaɓaaɗo e sahaa gooto.

model_answer: Ɓiɗɗo oo ina wondi e rafi bonɗo, ko wayi no ŋakkeende ñaamdu (malnutrition) e ŋakkeende Vitaamin A, ɗum ngaddi mo ñaamde leydi (pica), ŋakkeende semmbe, e caɗeele gite. question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer: Ɓingel maa wanii ko nyau sautu ɓuuɓɗum (severe pneumonia) ngam o ɗo fofa kadi ɓernde makko ɗo yaha jippa (chest in-drawing), ɗum ko ɗum waɗi o wawata nyamugo. Maande ɗe ko yaasiɗe ɗe mbaawi bonnude nguurndam makko, ɗum nafataa ko ari lekki kemist ɗen tan. Aɗa nyaami yahde e makko to opitaal saawre jooni ngam o heɓ kammu (oxygen) e inndeeji leɗɗe (antibiotics) ngam hisnude nguurndam makko. Tawde nyau nguu duumiino ko lewru, doktoor en ɗon ƴeewnda mo nyau wutte hono TB ngam anndude ko nafata mo. Wuru hokka mo lekki goɗɗi e saare maa waɗa caɗe, yahngan yeeso e opitaal woni ko safrata ɗum.

question: goɗɗo ɓe noddata subeeru duuɓi makko cappanɗe joyi nyannde ngon feere o fuɗɗi ƴowru arannde bo ƴowru ɗum yaaɗaayi ammaa nde ɗum faɓɓi asaweejo seɗɗa tan yaarugo lebbi ɓe hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum halloyi nde neeɓi seɗɗa sey ɗum saldoriimo poppe ɗum goonga on o haɓdi bawɗe ko o waawata hinde ko nyawuru ɗum sataayi ammaa ɗum pat manjum ɗum waɗaayi nde hannuno o nyamɗita ƴowru tolliti nde o hillitii dow o yaha o sooda lekki dikka o yaha nyawdorde o yi'a nyawtoowo nde o yokki nyawdorde o hecci ɓe o ɗo ɗujja lebbi tati ko saali o lori fayin o hecci ɓe o haɓdii ko o waawata waɗugo bana ko yimɓe shaawari mo ko laarani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum kaɗɗu heɓele ki ɗuuɗi ke ko o suudi dahaanuno o nyamɗita sell njomuru wari tulliti ɗunyotte ke wakkati feere fofo gomahe saldaromo ganjowuro ɗum nyaaɗi se o ƴami nyawtawo on ko waɗi nyowuru ɗum neeɓiri bane ni salu nyamɗitugo o yiɗi o anda ko waɗi dabareji ɓe leɗɗe ɗe o fuuɗi fuu nafayi ragaro men o ƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowuru ɗum ɗum nyamɗita fuumaru ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani o lornita jam ɓandu makko
reference:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma  de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha  Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki  Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali.  O lori  fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani  o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
model_answer: Ɓuuɓri ƴowru ndun e ganaari (chills) ɗum ina hollita ko ñawu ɓuuɓri ƴowru (epididymo-orchitis) sabu infeeksiyoŋ, walla ñawu ndiyam (hydrocele) walla ɓuuɓri (hernia) ɓurndi heewde e duuɓi makko ɗin. Yaññere (goro) e leɗɗe galleeji ɗe o fuuɗi ɗen nafataa, sabu ɗe potaani ñawu nguu kadi mbaawaa sellnude ñawu ngu jokkondirngu e lebbi. Omo haani hootde to safrirde ngam waɗde ƴeewndorgal ƴowru (ultrasound) e ƴeewnude asaweeji (urine test) ngam ñawdoowo oo annd ko feewti e makko. So ko infeeksiyoŋ, o maa njofo antibiotik moƴƴo, kono so ko hydrocele walla hernia, omo needi ƴettugol (operation) ngam dañde cellal. Woppude dabbare galleeji kala e ƴeewtaade to ñawdorde ko tan waawata rokkude mo jam ɓanndu makko.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer: Rufugo iyam dudi masin e lornugo sembe ɓaawo danygo ko nyawu geɗe nguurndam, wonaa ko nandi, o ɗaɓɓi yahde sibiti jooni. Sibiti ɓe mbara hokkude ndiyam nder cippi (IV fluids), kuutorgal bana Oxytocin walla Misoprostol ngam tiiɗtinde reedu ngam dartinde iyam, e ɗabbuneede jiyam ngam hokkude semmbe. Hokku ɓingel mako ƴamre no weeɓi, ɗum wallata reedu tiiɗtude e dartinde rufugo iyam. Wata a ɗaccu o yam leɗɗe gure walla kuutorgal gure, ɗe waawi bonnude cellal maako ɓurde. Lornugo sembe mako ngol hollata ko o heewi iyam (anemia), ɗum waɗata ko sibiti ko ɗaɗɗude ngam daɗndude nguurndam maako e maɓɓe ɗoo fof.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer: Nyawu dattijo on ko Cerebrospinal Meningitis (nyawu ƴiiƴam haa nder hoore), ko nyawu bonɗo saakteteeɗo e mboros hono kokhaku e fiiɗde. Alamaaji makko ɗii ko ɓuuɓri, ƴeewndo hoore tiiɗnde, ɓuuɓri daande, e mboros ɓanndu, ɗum fof ko baakteeriya waɗata ɗum. Omo haani nawteede safrirde jaajol ngam heɓde safaara nder ƴiiƴam (IV antibiotics) ngam hisnude nguurndam makko, sabu leɗɗe walla safaara galleeji maa njaɓaa ɗum. Nyawu nguu ina saaktoo, ɗum waɗi woɗɓe ina poti seerndi e makko haa o safriraa. Yimɓe ɓe nganndi e makko no feewi ina poti kadi yahde doktoor ngam heɓde toɓɓe (safaara) ngam haɗde heɓde ñawu nguu.

Wakati fere odo fi’a o do lara dowre, owala laara boddum to o ummi odo wancha. Mi hirliti odo silla akai akai bo dundum bo. Dumedon watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do? model_answer: Eey, ko ɓuri teeŋtude e alkawaliji ɗin ko ma ñawu jeyan shuga (diabetes mellitus), ko wayi no yarde ndiyam keewɗam, duƴƴe geɗe heewɗe kollirteeɗe e jamma, famɗude teddeendi ɓanndu, e ronooɓe. Alamaaji jeyan shuga potɗi anndeede ko heewde yarde ndiyam, duƴƴe geɗe keewɗe, heblaare duumiinde, e famɗude teddeendi ɓanndu ɗe nganndu-ɗaa ko ɗe njiytata omo waawi heɓde safaa. E nguurdam, omo waawi ñaamude cereeji e ƴiye keewɗi ɗi ngalaa shuga keewɗo, o woppa yarde njaram ɗam shukaare, o yaro ndiyam laaɓɗam. Tiiɗno nawo mo to doktoor ko yaawa ngam ƴeewndude mo, woto o wondir heen leɗɗe aadaaji tawa ƴeewndo waakaani, nde tawnoo ɗe mbaawa bonnude koyngal (kidney) e heedu (liver) makko.

question: redujo wari sibiti kikkiɗe ɗo sey o wi gorko maako ɗo holina mo akai akai ɓe ɗo dufa mo kullum o wi ɗo wati mo o dinga hurtugo nyalanɗe ɗuɗɗum to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sey o ɗo hurtira ngam o ɗo dami ta o tappan mo ko o huɗan mo o hirliti fuu ɓerde mako ɗo dogga ɗo fiya o dilli hawnugo sembe iyam mako sey o tawi ɗo wa'i sey o wi'i o tori ballinde ha saare mako be o yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo wanni mo bayani ko fe'ata kanjum ɗon saare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam ɓawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa hurturgo sosai ɗon to ɗo hota saare ko to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta ɗume on o waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓerde mako wala jam e hakkilo

 Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata.  Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.

model_answer: Kulol ɗam e ɓernde yaawde hawnude ɗe o mari ɗen ko ɓuuɓol hakkille (anxiety/PTSD) ɗe ngaddi ko sabu fitinaaji e tooñannge gorko makko ɗin. Lekkiiji gaddaaji ɗii nafataa ko sabu rafi o jeyaa ko e hakkille e ƴiiƴe dammuje, wonaa ko ɓanndu tan. Omo foti arde suudu nyawndeeji ngam rokkoreede lekkiiji kiiɗtinkoɗi kulol ɗam e heɓde yeewtere ballal (counselling) ngam wallitde mo jogaade hakkille. E sabu nguurndam makko ena nder kisre e tooñannge ngol, o foti ɗaɓɓude ballal ummii e ardiiɓe renndo malla kiiseeji ngam seertude e gorko oo. Kala ko ɗe kawri ɗen ko kanko njuɓɓinii peeje kisal e safrirde, ngam ko ɗum tan woni yo o heɓata jam e hakkillaaji makko.

reference:
Daada je wondi ha daadirabe je waddata bikkoi mappe tufugo baatal ofamtini  o ye’u kecchel mako do mari damuwa ha hundeko mako, bo lebol mingel mai o wadi buluu .
Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.
Dumedon watata lebol mingel wada buluu banni? Dume don kuma waddata mingel torra bo heba damuwa foofugo to’ do musina? Lekki don be hokkatanaaa, ko be larai mingel mai na?
model_answer:
Alamaaji ɗii bana juuɗe ɓaleeje (blue), torra heɓugo henndu, kufol mawngol e ƴawre nder hunnduko, hollayi ɓingel ngel mari nyaw ɓalndu (pneumonia) mawɗo, tawa o alaa ko yottata henndu (oxygen) e nder ƴiiƴe makko. 
Waɗugo juuđe ɗee ɓaleeje ko sabu ɓalndu nduu yani, ɗum waɗata ɗum ƴiiƴe ɗee mbaawataa rokkude ɓernde ndiyam ɗam (oxygen), ɗum noon ko nyaw bonɗo no feewi waawɗo warmin o acca ko yaawi. 
On foti yahde e ɓingel ngel to safrirde (hospital) ko yaasi, ɗo doktoor hokkoto mo oxygen e kuɗe (antibiotics) bana Ceftriaxone ngam haɓa e nyaw o. 
Ɗuum nyaw waawataa feewniree e leɗɗe suudu walla leɗɗe yeeyeteeɗe, sabu ko haaju cellal teeŋtungal ngam hisnude nguurndam makko. 
Tawa e laawol ngol hokka mo ƴamunde so o waawi, kono ko teeŋtunde ko ngaddan mo to doktoor ko ɓuri joona.

question: dada joɗata ha fattude amin ɗo mari redu je ɓingel mako ɗiɗabo ha fuɗɗere redu mai komai o yaha dai- dai o ɗo nana belɗum ɓingel fere ɗo wara amma lewru seɗɗa ko saali ɗo o fuɗɗi nanugo les redu mako ɗo nawa nyande nawɗum mai waɗi mo sossai har dakai o darata boɗɗum neɓai sam ɓawo ton o fuɗɗi rufugo iyam sossai rufugo iyam mai nda no rufata ɗon ba rufi sossai kuma watti mo tuni o do somi nde o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri ta ni ɗon ko fe'i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi valli mo ɓeyahi sibiti ɗemle am kanjum ɗume ɗon watata nawugo les redu haa redujo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo alama hattara ɗon nana jey dada ko ɓingel haa redu may ɗume on alama goɗɗo larata redu may ɗon damuwa ɗon lekki jey darnata nawɗum may na ɓeddarna iyam may jey nawnata ɓingel may
reference: Daada, joodata ha  fattude amin. Do mari redu je mingel mako didabu. A fuddurde reedu mai komai oyaha daidai, odo nana beldum bingel feere do wara . Amma lewru sedda ko saalido ofuddi nanugo les reedu mako do naawa. Yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai, har daker o darata boddum. Nebai sam, bawo toin ofuddi rufugo eyam sosai . Rufugo eyam mai da no rufata don ba, rufi sosai kuma waati mo chomri odo Sommi. Dai o laari eyam mai, sai o hurtili taani don ko fe’di be bingel mako. Gorko mako yawi vallimo be yahi sibiti. Demde am kanju, dume don watata nawugo les reedu ha reedujo? Rufugo eyam sosai do alaama hattara don na je daada ko bingel ha redu mai? Dumedon alaama goddo laarata redu mai don damuwa? Don lekki je darnata naudum mai na be darna eyam mai je nawnata bingel mai?
model_answer: Dada, ɗuum ɗo ɓingel ngel waɗata ko waawi wonde ko rafi ƴiiƴam (UTI) walla ko ɗum ɗo o ɗaɓɓata ngam deeƴnude hoore makko (infantile masturbation), ɗum ko heewi feeñde caggal rafi 'redu' kono ɗum wonaa ko 'redu' woni tan. Lekkiiji ɗi ɓe ndarnata mo ɗoo nafataa mo, ɗum ko ɗum waɗi ƴeewngo doktoor ko laaɓɗi ngam anndude rafi ngoo. Ko himmende yo ɓe ngaddu mo doktoor ngam ƴeewde ko wonaa rafi 'sawa' (seizures) walla caɗe ngaandi (neurological issues), e ƴeewde ƴiiƴam makko (urine test). So tawii ko rafi ƴiiƴam woni, doktoor maa rokk mo lekkiiji potɗi ɗi mbaawi hisnude mo; kono so tawii ko ɗum tan ko ɗo o ɗaɓɓata ngam deeƴnude hoore makko, ɗum alaa ko nafata lekki kono ɗum maa ɓooy-ɓooya o woppata ɗum. Yo ɓe njokku e rokkude mo nyaamdu selluɗu e ballal ngam ɓeydude cellal makko, ɗum maa wallu mo e ɓeydagol makko.

question: likita daada joɗata haa sare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum nde o yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso na kanjum tamba nden bo fofugo ɓingel may canji o ɗo fofa bana yaha dow dow ɓeɗo jippa les les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata wani fofugo ɓalleji ɗo dilla ni dada may o ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel may wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolwa ɓingel may to sey o wi ha o yaha sibiti o lara likita koyninamo ɓingel mako ɗemne am ɗume on latata ɓingel heɓa damuwa musungo boɗɗum no ɓingel may fofata ɗo alama nyamu fere ɗon na alamaji hattara toy dada be ɓaɓa ɓingel may hakkilinta ɗume on wattata ɓingel petel wolwugo to ɗo musina
reference:
Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako. 
 Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer: Alamaaji ɗii kollitii ko ɓingel ngel heɓi ñawu boŋngol wiyeteengo Pertussis (ñaawu musugo ɓuuɓngu) walla ɓerɗe ɓuuɓɗe tiiɗɗe, ɗo musugo ngoo tiiɗaa, ɓingel ngel ƴetta henndu woowndu (whoop), nden bo fofata. Ɗum ko ñawu kulngu, sabu ɓingel ngel waawi ŋakkude henndu (hypoxia) walla fuɗɗaade dilla, ɗum ko tawa yumma mum ina yoawi yahde e ɓingel ngel to sibiti jooni jooni ngam ƴeewndaade likita. Woppu rokkude dogdu walla leɗɗe sukaaɓe ɗe njogata e galle, kono e sibiti ɗo, likita maa rokk ɓingel ngel henndu (oxygen) so tawii ina haani, e leɗɗe yeru Azithromycin ngam safrude e haɗde ñawu nguu yaajde. Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100.  Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai  watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta  ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?
Be kuma dume don jaumu redu wadata da yotta irinbanni bako owonna banni?
model_answer: Ko ɗum ko sembe iyam ɗe debbo jahroowo woni (preeclampsia), ɗe o ndara ko ɓuuɓri ɓanndu, mette hoore, e mawnugol ƴiiƴam, ɗum noon ko nyawu bonɗu no feewi wonande yumma e ɓiyum. Leɗɗe ɗe o ndokkaa ngam ustude sembe iyam ɗe (jamu redu) ɗe ko ɗe mbaawi addande ko o ñaamata ko yaltata e ƴattooje ɓanndu, ɗum noon ina haani yo o hollite doktoor ko yaawi ngam waylude lekki man. Dowkugol koyɗe walla hoore fof alaa ko nafata ɗum, sabu ɓuuɓri ɓanndu ndi ko caɗe e nder reedu e ƴiiƴam (protein) woni ko addanta ɗum, wonaa ko dowri. Ɗum ko nyawu kaawisɗo no feewi wonande debbo jahroowo, ɗum noon omo haani nawteede to safrirde mawnde oon ñalawma. To safrirde nden, doktoor on maa jokku sembe iyam makko e reende ɓiyum e juuɗe mum.

question: ɓawo mi danyi ɓandu am fuɗɗi hoynugo kikiɗe fere ni mi numi tunda dai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam hafa to de am to mi yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum diyam ɓeddoti mi naftirta mi numi am hafa handi ni ɓiɗo hakkina hore am miɗo yiwa boɗɗum to kigide fere bo wari mi nanai belɗum ɓandu am mi fuɗɗi nanugo jahagol be ɓandu am fuɗɗi diwunugo kullum kullum da miɗo nana jagol bo hauti be ɓandu am belɗum feyin semi hirliti iyam jey vurtata ɓawo daigo ɗon haccega minanata daga totton bo velai bo haccega mayi ɗuɗi bo meɗai feɗugo beyam mikasi ittugo gite am daga totton demi ummi sai ɗon miyahi sibiti mi'ema ko ndiyam labɗam jemi naftirta miyiwa bemai kamjum on wadda takalayam bawo daygo
reference: Bawo mi dayi , bandu am fuddi hoinugo , kikide fere ni minumi, tunde dai en wala diam labdam ha fattude amin, to idi mi yiiwa kullum kullum diam be dotti , minaftirita , mi numii amma fah haadi ni mido hakkilona hore am mido yiiwa boddum. Toh kikide fere bo wari , mi nanei beldum bandu am. Mi fuddi nanugo jaagol , be bandu am fuddi dewnugo kullum kullum . Da mido naana jaagol, bo hauti be bandu am vellai fein. Se mi hirliti eyam je vurtata bawo dayugo don hacchega mi nannata daga ton bo vellai bo. Hacchega mai duudi bo meddai fudugo be am  bo. Mi kaasi ittugo gite am daga totton. Dai mi ummi, sai don miyahi sibiti mi emma ko diyam labdam je mi naftiri ta mi yiwa be mai kanjum don waddata kala yeu bawo dayugo.
model_answer: Alamaaji maa ɗin kollitii ko ñawu mboro (infection) bonngu caggal jibineede maa, ko wayi no ɓuuɓri nder reedu (puerperal sepsis) walla ñawu ƴiiƴam (UTI), tawa ina yahdi e nguleendi ɓanndu e yaltugol ƴiiƴam ɓuuɓɗam. Ngam haɗaade caɗeele mawɗe ɗe mbaawi warde nguurndam, aɗa foti hootde safrirde (sibiti) ko yaawi ngam ƴettude leɗɗe nder ƴiiƴam (IV antibiotics) e ƴeewteede. Tiiɗno humpit-ɗo doktoor on wonde leɗɗe ɗe nganndu-ɗaa ko ɗe ngalaa ko nafata, nde o waylu leɗɗe ɗee walla o ƴeewndo mboro on ɓeyda. Nde ɗartataa to galle, ƴettu ndiyam laɓɗam no feewi ngam wallitde ɓanndu maa ɓuuɓde e woppude mboro on. Hoto ɗaɓɓo leɗɗe goɗɗe e nokkuuji ɀngalaa safrirde laawɗunde, nde tawnoo ñawu nguu ina ɗaɓɓi toppitagol safrirde tiiɗngol.

question: addirawo am danyi ɓinngel debbo balɗe saali sey o laari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo wala foofa boɗɗum wakkati feere ɓinngel man yofta kosam bamo fofɗe maako ta'i yande woore daada ɓinngel timmini musungo mo bee jemma sey o laari leɓɓi ɓinngel ba wala ba wayliti seɗɗa seɗɗa sey o tampi ko o waɗata sey o goɗi ɓamtugo ɓinngel man ngam o heɓa o foofa boɗɗum ammaa bo ɓinngel gaagiri foofugo boɗɗum bee boo canjugo leɓɓi ɓinngel man sey o yaawi o hoosi ɓinngel o yaari asibiti ngam ɓe laaranamo ɓinngel may ɗume on canjini ɓinngel man leɓɓal nden bo walaa aybe no ɓinngel foofata na ko bo nyawuɓe nde walla nyawu hanta dasinta ɓinngel man foofugo bee bone ɗume on alaamaaji kalluɗum jee saarooji waatinta hakkiilo ɗume on agaji ɓe waawata hokkugo ɓinngel mo foofata bee bone
reference:
Addirawo am dayi bingel debbo balde sali ,sai o lari ba kala wakkati o misinta mo o wala fofa boddum,wakkati fere bingel man yofta ta kossam bamo pofde mako ta ee,yenda wore,dada bingel timmini musungo mo be jemma,sai o lari lebbi bingel ba wailiti sedda sedda,sai o tampi ko o wadata,sai o godi bamtugo bingel mai gam o heba o fofa boddum,amma bo bingel gagiri fofugo boddum,be bo chanjugo lebbi bingel man,sai o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be larinamo bingel mai,

Dume on aagaji be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone
model_answer: Foofugo ɓural teemedere wona ko saba kadi ko maande nyau mawnde (ko wayi no nyau juulde walla sepsis), ɗum addanata ɓuuɓnude, ɓeydagol leppi (abdominal distension), e ɓaleeje (jaundice) ɗe njiɗaa ƴeewndo safrirde yaawngo. Alaamaaji kalluɗe ɗe poti reende ko woppude foofugo, ɓeydagol ɓaleeje ɗe ɓanndu, wumre maa ƴiiɓde, e ɓuuɓnude ko ɓuri heewde. Agaji ɗo o waawi hokkude ko wuddude kosam makko o huutora spoone maa kaɓirgol ngam wallitde ɓinngel ngel yoora, tawa o reeni mo nguleendi. Ko ɗakkere yaawe ɓinngel ngel yahsaa e safrirde ngam heɓde toppitagol ko wayi no jalɓugol annoore (phototherapy) e ɗoonge nder ƴiiƴe (IV fluids) ngam hisnude nguurndam maako. Ndeen ɗum ko sabu ɓinngel maa danyaaɗo seeɗa waawaa woppude foofugo tawa alaa caɗeele cellal; leppi ɓeydude e yoorngo ina hollita nyau baawɗo warde ɗum so tawii njiytaaka safriraa yaawngo.

question: debbo jomu redu reduma lebbi jewego minɗo wondi saare gotel fuɗɗi hirugo dow ɓernde maako ɗo fiya be lawlaw a viya mo timmini doggugo jottam wakkati fere bo oɗo soma ko o huway ko ɗume debbo jungo maako ɗo hawtidira seɗɗa satiji saali seɗɗa o lari dande maako ɗo uppa hedi yeso sai o hultiri oɗo numa ɗo kam ɗo nder nyawu damata jomu redu na ko bo ɗum nyawu fere on sai o taski nyawugo lara likita ngam o anda ɗume sanadu nyawɗo emol haɗo ɗume on waddini debbo redujo ɗo fiyal ɓerde be law law ɗo a viya mo timmini doggugo nden bo ɗume on sanadu uppugo dande ɗo nden bo irin nyawu ɗo kam wawan mema mawnugo ɓingel redu mako ɗo na ɗume on alamaji kalluɗum je ɓe wattinta gite hasare ba irin nyawu ko kuje yareyareji on handi o dayinta ko bo wodi je ko ɓeddata nyawugo ha irin wakkati ɗo
reference:
Debbo Jomu redu reduman lebbi jego,mindo wondi sare gotel,fuddi hirrugo do berde mako do fiya be lau lau,aviya mo timmini dongugo jotta,wakkati fere bo o do soma ko o huwai ko dume,denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda,satiji sali sedda o lari dade mako do uppa heddi yeso,sai o hultiri,o do nummado kam do der yauwu damata jomu redu nah ko bo dum yauwu fere on,sai o taski yehugo lara likita gam andugo dume sanadu yauw do.
Yammol ha do ,dume on waddini debbo redujo do fiyal berde be lau lau do aviya bo timmini doggugo?

model_answer: Nyawu ngu debbo on mariɗo ko Eklamsiya (nyawu ƴiiƴam ɓernde ɗam mawni), ɗum addani mo majjere e ƴellitgol juɗe e koyɗe (seizures), ɗum wonaa doggugol gañum. Fiylugol ɓernde maako be lawlaw ko bonngu no feewi, ina waawi yirbude reedu (uterine rupture), ko kadi ɗum waddaali mawnugo ɓingel ngel, ko ɗum tan addani ƴellitgol taska maako. Hay debbo reduɗo haa lebbi sappo ina waawi jibinde ɓingel mawnuɗo, kono Eklamsiya ko gaño e nguurndam yumma e ɓiɗɗo on so o safranaake jooni. Alamuje kalluɗe ɗe poti reeneede ɗe ko: ɓuuɓgol hoore tiiɗngol, jippagol gite (blurred vision), ɓuuɓgol yeeso, e ɓiɗɗo on ɗaɓɓaaki nder reedu. O foti ko yaawnude etaade haa safrirde mawnde ngam rokke leɗɗe haɗe ƴiiƴam (Magnesium sulfate) e yaltinde ɓiɗɗo on ngam hisnude nguurndam maɓɓe ɗimmam.

question: mi hakkili miko amperti domo vowi fiji gobe so birabe mako canji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan judo taya sudu mako kullum o acce yauta gobo o wala fala ko vowi hidigo mi hakkili bo komi ninje woni sare o yidai nyamugo be amin odon andi mo woni dar billa ko chomri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata mettol berde on na ko torruko hakkilo on damata mun hertoi min wawata vallugo mun gam seyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko shawara na ko likita mon den yahu jeberde

Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? model_answer: Mettol ɓernde ngol e kulol ngel seerndaaɗo on nattii, ina haani o ƴeewtetee to safrirde ngam ƴeewde ƴiiƴam makko (BP) e ɓernde makko, sabu ina waawi wonde ko haala ɓernde ɓalliindi. So tawii ko ɓernde nde cellal, ɗuum ko famɗi fof ko kulol hakkille (anxiety) walla miijo ngo ɓata e ɓalndu, ngu keewi feeñde e sahaa jibineende walla dewugal. Miɗo wasiya yo o yah to doktoor ngam heɓde wasiyaaji laaɓtuɗi, tawa ina waawi rokkude mo leɗɗe ɗe deeƴnana hakkille makko. Kadi, e nder renndo amen, ballude mo e dewal e haaldude e makko e jam, ko huunde moƴƴere ngam deeƴnude hakkille makko. Ƴeewtorde ɗum to doktoor ko adii fof ko huunde tigi-rigi, ngam haɗde caɗe ɗe mbaawi arode e nder cellal makko.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel mo lewru jeegum ngam o mari fofa e yitere nder ɓalndu o sali wajde, ina waawi heɓde maleriya walla ƴiiƴam nder ɓalndu (gastroenteritis). Alamaaji ɗin ɗoo ko hasare jamma, nguleendi (fofa), sali musnugo, e sali fijirde no o winndirta nii. Haani meeɗen ɓamta ɗen yahde e ɓingel ngel to suudu safrirdu ngam ƴeewnde ƴiiƴam (RDT) ngam anndude ko heɓi ngel hade ndokkude lekki kala potiɗe. Nde o mari nguleendi, ndokku mo paracetamol sirup heeruɗo e ɓuuɓnude mo ndiyam ƴoƴɗam ngam ustude nguleendi nden. Ngam haɗde ɗuum, huuɓtu ɓingel ngel e nder tolli (mosquito net) jamma fof ngam reende maleriya, hisna mo juvɗe, e ndokku mo ñamnde laaɓnde.

question: rawandu gati bingel banɗan dubi mako jeɗiɗi de rawandu mai gati mo e yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta'i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum a foro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuɗɗi wurtugo namputure bo ɓuti e yecci ɓe yara mo asibiti useni iri kalariroye toy e wannata ɓingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo wutandu gam rawandu may koda rawandu may ɗo dama bo iri sabandi toy hani e wanna ɓingel petel ɗo mandoro wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Ɓiɗɗo on heɓiima ƴawol rawandu (omphalitis) e ƴawol nder ƴiiƴam (neonatal sepsis) sabu ko ɓe ndarni e ɗuum leɗɗe aadaaji ɗe ngaddi ko faande. 
"Namputure" ɗee ko ɓeydol gootel (umbilical granuloma) ngol sabu ko faande, kadi caɗeele wuttudu ɗe ɓiɗɗo on heɓata ɗee ko sabu ƴawol ngol yaajii e nder ɓanndu maɓɓe. 
Ɗoongel ngel ina haani jooni ina woppaa to safrirde ngam heɓde antibiotik e nder ƴiiƴam (IV) e ndokkude ballal wuttudu ngam hisnude nguurndam mum. 
Ko laaɓti wonde caɗeele ɗee puɗɗorii ko e rawandu ngo, kono ko ƴawol ngol ɓadtii nder ƴiiƴam, ɗum woodani ko safaara tiiɗɗo doktoor waɗata jooni. 
Woppoɗen kuutoragol leɗɗe aadaaji e rawandu sukaaɓe, nde tawnoo ko ɗum addata ko faamɗe mawɗe ɗe mbaawi warde ɓiɗɗo oo.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Nyawu ngu ɓingel ngel mari ko ƴattaare (convulsions), ɗum waawi ummoraade e zazzabi ɓurtuɗo, walla ñawu mawngu ko wayi no zazzabi ɓuuɓuɗo (cerebral malaria) walla ɓuuɓgol ƴiiƴam hoore (meningitis). Nde ɓingel ngel waɗata jonɗo e wala nder hakkilo, ɗum hollitii ko ƴiiƴam nder hoore maɓɓe ƴattii, ɗum noon ko nyawu bonɗu no haaniri yaawre. Ndeeɗoo sahaa, ndottinee ɓingel ngel e sara ngo ngam yo dañu he wuyngo, woppaa ko woni e nder hannde mum ngam haɗaade ƴiiƴam ɓuuɓnude, yaajnee yahde to opitaal seeɗa. To opitaal, doktoor maa rokke kuɗe ngam dartinde ƴattaare ɗen, kam e kuɗe ngam safrude zazzabi o ko wayi no Artesunate. Hoto hokkira ɓingel ngel leɗɗe galleeji walla wuro, tawa ko ɗum ko yaawi ɓe poti heɓde safaara sahaaɗo ngam haɗaade maayde walla saabaade bonannde e hoore.

Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. model_answer: Pewol ngol e hoore ɓingel ngel ko heewi wuyde sabu tuggol ɓanndu e laawol danygol (ko wiyetee Caput succedaneum), ɗum ko ɓuuɓri ndiyam nde heewa heɗaade tawa ko sellaani, ɗum maa woppu ko ɓooyi balɗe seeɗa. Musugo ɗam e juurooje ɗee ko kewɗe e sukaaɓe kesi sabu ɓulluuji ƴiiƴe maɓɓe seeɗa, ɗum waɗata ɓe nana henndu tawa ko bana tagoore kon, ɗum ɗaɓɓirta ko ko ɓingel ngel ƴama nebbam ƴiiƴam (breastmilk) tan ɗe poti. "Damba" walla cemte ɗe o waɗata mbaawaa ko ɗemɗe tago (jitteriness), kono so tawii ko ɗe nanaa ɓeydude walla o wanaa semmbe, ko haani hawrude e doktoor ngam ƴeewde ƴiiƴam (sugar) walla ñawu nguu. Woppa tooñude ɓingel ngel e ƴettugol muus ɗam ko ɓuri dabbunde, huutoro ko ndiyam suukara (saline) seeɗa tan ngam neɓtaade ɗam. So tawii ɓingel ngel wanaa ƴamde, walla o jogii hari (fever), walla o ɓeydii foofa, yah e opitaal ngam ɓeydaade ƴeewteede.

Mbayka ɗo o woni ɗoo—o ŋakkii semmbe, o somi gite, o yi'aali laɓɗum, o fe'i bannin—ina hollira ko o majjii ko ƴiiƴam (jippa boɗɗum) walla ko ɗuum waɗii mo ŋakkeende ndiyam e suukara ɓaawo danygol.
